arguments.sql:
WITH joined AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id, p.height, pa.heading_accuracy
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
    LEFT JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) FROM Player AS p) AS non_unique_or_null_player_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player AS p WHERE p.height IS NOT NULL AND TYPEOF(p.height) NOT IN ('integer', 'real')) AS nonnumeric_heights,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player AS p WHERE p.height > 180) AS tall_players,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes) AS source_attribute_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
    COUNT(player_api_id) AS matched_rows,
    COUNT(heading_accuracy) AS recorded_heading_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL AND TYPEOF(heading_accuracy) NOT IN ('integer', 'real') THEN 1 END) AS nonnumeric_heading_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN height > 180 AND heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN player_api_id END) AS eligible_players
FROM joined

input.question: For each year before 1975 with recorded winner times, what was the mean race winner elapsed time in seconds? Round the exact mean to two decimal places; if it is exactly halfway, round away from zero. Order by year.

--- before.sql
+++ after.sql
@@ -1,16 +1,18 @@
 WITH race_winner_times AS (
+    -- Shared winners can repeat the same elapsed time for a race.
     SELECT DISTINCT r.year, r.raceId, res.milliseconds
-    FROM races AS r
-    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
+    FROM main.races AS r
+    JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
     WHERE r.year < 1975
       AND res.position = 1
       AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
 )
 SELECT
     year,
+    -- Round the nonnegative mean to whole hundredths using integer arithmetic.
     ((SUM(milliseconds) + 5 * COUNT(*)) / (10 * COUNT(*))) / 100.0
         AS mean_winner_elapsed_seconds
 FROM race_winner_times
 GROUP BY year
 ORDER BY year
-LIMIT 1000
+LIMIT -1

WITH winner_records AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId, res.milliseconds,
           substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS hours,
           substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1) AS minutes_and_seconds
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.position = 1
),
winner_times AS (
    SELECT *,
           CAST(hours AS INTEGER) * 3600000
           + CAST(minutes_and_seconds AS INTEGER) * 60000
           + CAST(substr(minutes_and_seconds, instr(minutes_and_seconds, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
           + CAST(substr(substr(minutes_and_seconds, instr(minutes_and_seconds, '.') + 1) || '000', 1, 3) AS INTEGER)
               AS text_milliseconds
    FROM winner_records
),
yearly AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS races, SUM(milliseconds) AS sum_ms
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT year, raceId, milliseconds FROM winner_records)
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT year, races, sum_ms,
       sum_ms % (10 * races) AS rounding_remainder,
       5 * races AS halfway_remainder,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM winner_times AS w
        WHERE w.year = yearly.year AND w.text_milliseconds IS NOT w.milliseconds) AS text_time_mismatches
FROM yearly
ORDER BY year

    -- Shared winners can repeat the same elapsed time for a race.
    SELECT DISTINCT r.year, r.raceId, res.milliseconds
    FROM main.races AS r

    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND res.position = 1
      AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    year,
    -- Round the nonnegative mean to whole hundredths using integer arithmetic.
    ((SUM(milliseconds) + 5 * COUNT(*)) / (10 * COUNT(*))) / 100.0
        AS mean_winner_elapsed_seconds
FROM race_winner_times
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
LIMIT -1

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS qualifying_lab_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS qualifying_lab_patients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.ID IS NOT NULL THEN l.ID END) AS matched_patients,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(l.TG) <> 'integer' THEN 1 END) AS qualifying_noninteger_results,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Laboratory WHERE TG IS NOT NULL AND typeof(TG) <> 'integer') AS noninteger_results,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Patient WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL AND (DATE(Birthday) IS NULL OR Birthday <> DATE(Birthday))) AS nonstandard_birthdays,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.TG = 200 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_at_threshold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Birthday = DATE('2026-10-09', '-50 years') THEN p.ID END) AS patients_on_50th_birthday,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Birthday > DATE('2026-10-09', '-51 years')
                       AND p.Birthday < DATE('2026-10-09', '-50 years') THEN p.ID END) AS patients_past_50th_before_51st,
  MAX(l.Date) AS latest_qualifying_lab_date
FROM main.Laboratory AS l
LEFT JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
LIMIT 1
